title: Bullhorn takes staffing platform offline to contain cyberattack
description: Bullhorn, a cloud-based staffing software company, experienced a cyberattack that caused a system-wide outage, leading the company to disable access to its platform to contain the incident. The company has isolated the issue and eradicated the immediate threat, with ongoing efforts to restore services after security reviews with CrowdStrike. It is not yet confirmed whether customer data was exfiltrated. Several major services remain degraded or offline, while some continue to operate. Bullhorn requires non-SSO users to reset passwords and mandates API password rotations to protect integrations. The company will notify affected individuals if a data breach is confirmed.
aiSummary: Bullhorn suffered a cyberattack resulting in a system-wide outage of its staffing platform. The company responded by temporarily disabling system access to contain the attack and engaged CrowdStrike specialists for security reviews. A forensic investigation is underway, but it is not yet determined if customer data was compromised. The attack affected multiple services including ATS/CRM, Automation, and Talent Platform, with some services remaining operational. Bullhorn has implemented password resets for non-SSO users and API password rotations to secure integrations. Data exports are available on request to minimize disruption, and unposted time records will be reprocessed after restoration. No timelines for full service restoration have been provided.
aiImpact: The cyberattack caused a system-wide outage impacting Bullhorn's staffing platform and multiple associated services, disrupting recruitment lifecycle management for over 10,000 customers worldwide. The outage affected job posting, ATS/CRM, automation, back office, and other critical services, leading to degraded or unavailable functionality. It is currently unknown if any customer data was exfiltrated. The incident has operational and potential data confidentiality impacts for Bullhorn's customers. The company’s response includes containment, eradication of the immediate threat, and ongoing forensic investigation.
